body: Acres Loan Origination LLC, an affiliate of commercial mortgage lender Acres Capital, has filed a foreclosure complaint in New York state Supreme Court against the Auden Buffalo student housing community at 2915-2949 N. Forest Road in Amherst, Buffalo Business First reported, according to Connect CRE's roundup for the week of August 13, 2026. The defendant is an affiliate of DMG Investments, a New York City real estate developer.

In the complaint, Acres says it made two loans totaling $32.5 million in early 2021 to finance construction of Auden Buffalo, and that the loan matured in January 2024 with all of the principal still unpaid.

The filing came days after a group of lenders represented by Deutsche Bank National Trust Co. began foreclosure proceedings against Air Buffalo, an apartment building at 1265 Sweet Home Rd. that is also owned by a DMG affiliate, according to the same report. Connect CRE's summary did not include a response from DMG.

timeline.label: Acres makes two construction loans totaling $32.5M for Auden Buffalo
The loan matures with the entire principal unpaid, according to Acres' complaint
A lender group represented by Deutsche Bank National Trust Co. starts foreclosure proceedings against DMG affiliate's Air Buffalo apartment building
Acres Loan Origination LLC files a foreclosure complaint against Auden Buffalo
